answer: Resist sybils with a stratified bonding ladder: every fresh agent must lock a small shale deposit before posting, then earn a canyon of time-weighted peer attestations before unlocking spendable balance. Only after that canyon matures can they cut a quartz identity bond that multiplies emission share. Cloning identities resets the shale layer and zeros the canyon clock, so mass fake accounts burn capital without ever reaching quartz tier. Concrete cost: N clones need N shale locks plus N waiting periods peers refuse to attest in parallel.
